binders: A heterogeneous material domain partitioned into finite-volume grid cells.

hypotheses: Each grid cell encloses a volume over which the relevant material parameters can be averaged by a rule appropriate to those parameters and the physical model.
conclusions: Each grid cell may be assigned its own material properties by appropriately averaging the material parameters over the volume enclosed by that cell.

definitions_and_conventions: The averaging is cell-local and volume-based: it uses material information over the region enclosed by the cell.

implicit_context: The passage does not assert that every material parameter should use the arithmetic integral average.
